observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a headlight assembly with visible part numbers and markings, including 'Made in Japan' and 'TOYOTA' embossed on the housing.
Photo 1 shows the front of the headlight with three main lights and a daytime running light bar above, with the amber turn signal on the right side.
Photo 2 shows the same headlight from a slightly different angle, with the amber turn signal illuminated, confirming it is the right-side headlight (driver's side in left-hand drive vehicles).
The headlight has a modern design with LED daytime running lights and three main projector lenses.
The back of the unit (photo 0) has a part number '81210-0T010' visible, along with 'TOYOTA' and 'Made in Japan'.

The seller claims it is a left-side headlight for a 2023-2025 Land Cruiser Prado, but the photos show the amber turn signal on the right side, which is the right-side headlight in left-hand drive vehicles (standard in Nigeria).

The part number 81210-0T010 is consistent with Toyota Land Cruiser Prado models from 2023-2025, but the exact year cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The design matches the 2023+ Prado.
Photo 0 shows 'TOYOTA' and 'Made in Japan' embossed on the back housing, along with a genuine part number 81210-0T010, which is consistent with original equipment.
